sub_theme: Famous Artists Recap and Final Art Project

lessons.title: Non-Fiction: Meet the Artists
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retrieve facts about artists studied this year.
success_criteria: I can find a fact about an artist.
I can answer a question using the text.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap artists studied this year (Van Gogh, Frida Kahlo, Matisse, Rousseau, Warhol).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a summary text about the artists studied, retrieving key facts.
lessons.independent_task: Children read and answer retrieval questions about the artists.
resources_needed: Summary text about artists studied this year
key_questions: What technique did this artist use?
Where did you find that fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Answer in full sentences using text evidence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cumulative art knowledge retrieval — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap facts found about the artists.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family about an artist you've learned about this year.

lessons.title: Shape and Colour Patterns in Art
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify shape and pattern in famous artworks.
success_criteria: I can name a shape in an artwork.
I can describe a pattern I see.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap shapes and patterns from earlier terms.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Look at artworks studied this year, identifying shapes and patterns within them.
lessons.independent_task: Children find and record shapes/patterns in a chosen artwork.
key_questions: What shape can you see here?
Is there a pattern?

differentiation.greater_depth: Identify multiple shapes/patterns and describe them

lessons.assessment_notes: Note maths-art cross-curricular application — evidence for MATHS.GEO.
lessons.home_link: Look for shapes and patterns in art or design at home.

lessons.title: Recapping the Artists We've Studied
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall and compare artists studied throughout the year.
success_criteria: I can name 3 artists studied this year.
I can say one thing about each.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a gallery of images from all artists studied this year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss each artist and their distinctive style/technique as a recap.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete an artist fact file recap for 3+ artists studied this year.
resources_needed: Artist images and information from the year
key_questions: What technique did this artist use?
Which was your favourite and why?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note cumulative art knowledge across the year — evidence for ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap all artists studied this year.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family about your favourite artist studied this year.

lessons.title: Writing About My Favourite Artist
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write sentences explaining their favourite artist and why.
success_criteria: I can write which artist I like.
I can write why I like their work.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a sentence explaining a favourite artist and reason.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 sentences about their favourite artist studied this year.
key_questions: Who is your favourite artist?
Why do you like their work?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note opinion writing with reasoning — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family about your favourite artist and why.

lessons.title: Fractions in My Final Art Project
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply fraction knowledge to plan a piece of art.
success_criteria: I can plan to colour half my artwork one colour.
I can plan a quarter in another colour.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model planning an artwork design using fractions (e.g. half blue, a quarter red, a quarter yellow).
lessons.independent_task: Children plan their final art project design using fraction proportions.
key_questions: What fraction will be this colour?
Does your plan add up to the whole?

differentiation.greater_depth: Plan using halves and quarters together

lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of fractions to a creative planning task — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.home_link: Plan a picture using fraction proportions of colour.

lessons.title: Starting My Final Art Project
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to begin creating a final art piece using a technique learned this year.
success_criteria: I can choose a technique I've learned.
I can begin my artwork.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap techniques learned this year (painting, printing, collage, sculpture).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss choosing a favourite technique for a final independent art project.
lessons.independent_task: Children begin their final art project, applying a chosen technique from the year.
key_questions: What technique are you using?
What inspired your design?

differentiation.support: Adult supports technique choice and start

lessons.assessment_notes: Note independent application of a technique learned this year — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Share progress on final art projects.
lessons.home_link: Think about how you'll finish your art project.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Art Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read art-themed words.
success_criteria: I can blend and read art words.
I can read a sentence about art.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a range of graphemes, blending art-themed words (e.g. 'paint', 'brush', 'colour').
lessons.independent_task: Children read art-themed word and sentence cards.
key_questions: Can you blend this word?
Can you read this sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application, an end-of-year fluency check — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading art words over the week.

lessons.title: Symmetry in My Final Art Project
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply symmetry to their final art project.
success_criteria: I can include a symmetrical element in my artwork.
I can explain how it's symmetrical.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss adding a symmetrical element to the final art project.
lessons.independent_task: Children continue their final art project, incorporating symmetry.
key_questions: Where is your symmetrical element?
How do you know it's symmetrical?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of symmetry to a creative project — evidence for MATHS.GEO.
lessons.home_link: Look for symmetry in art or objects at home.

lessons.title: Continuing My Final Art Project
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to develop their final art project with increasing detail.
success_criteria: I can add more detail to my artwork.
I can use my chosen technique confidently.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss adding detail and refining technique.
lessons.independent_task: Children continue developing their final art project.
key_questions: What detail will you add next?
How is your technique improving?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note development and refinement of technique over the project — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Share progress on final art projects.
lessons.home_link: Think about what you'll add tomorrow.

lessons.title: Practising My Art Presentation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to plan and rehearse a short presentation about their artwork.
success_criteria: I can plan what to say about my artwork.
I can rehearse my presentation.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap presenting skills practised across the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss planning a short presentation (what technique, what inspired you, what you're proud of).
lessons.independent_task: Children plan and rehearse their art presentation in pairs.
key_questions: What will you say about your artwork?
What are you most proud of?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note planning and rehearsal for a final presentation — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Practise your art presentation with your family.

lessons.title: Number Recap: Full Year Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply a range of number skills learned across Year 1.
success_criteria: I can count, add, subtract and compare confidently.
I can find halves and quarters.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key number vocabulary from the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the year's core number content.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed number review covering counting, addition, subtraction and fractions.
key_questions: What strategy will you use?
Can you check your answer?

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: End of Year 1 number consolidation summary for each child.
lessons.home_link: Review the year's number learning together.

lessons.title: Finishing My Final Art Project
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to complete their final art project.
success_criteria: I can finish my artwork.
I can add final touches.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss finishing touches and completing a project to a good standard.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete their final art project.
key_questions: What final touch will you add?
Are you happy with your finished piece?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note completion and pride in a finished piece, summarising the year's art progress — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Show your finished art project to your family.

lessons.title: Presenting My Final Art Project
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to present their final art project confidently to the class.
success_criteria: I can present my artwork.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss final tips for confident presenting.
lessons.independent_task: Children present their final art project to the class or a small group, answering questions.
key_questions: What technique did you use?
What are you most proud of?

differentiation.greater_depth: Present unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cumulative spoken language and art reflection progress across Year 1 — evidence for ENG.SL1/ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all the final art project presentations.
lessons.home_link: Present your finished art project to your family.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Shape and Measurement Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply shape and measurement skills learned across Year 1.
success_criteria: I can name 2D and 3D shapes.
I can measure length, mass and capacity.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key shape and measurement vocabulary from the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the year's core shape and measurement content.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed shape and measurement review.
key_questions: What shape is this?
Which is longer/heavier?

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: End of Year 1 shape and measurement consolidation summary for each child.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the year's shape and measurement learning.

lessons.title: Year 1 Art Gallery Exhibition
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to display and reflect on their art progress across Year 1.
success_criteria: I can display my final project.
I can talk about how my art has improved this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art created across the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on progress made in art skills and techniques across the year.
lessons.independent_task: Children display their final art project in a class exhibition, reflecting on their progress.
key_questions: How has your art improved this year?
What are you most proud of?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reflection on progress and technique

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and progress recognition across the year's art learning — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.home_link: Invite your family to see (or hear about) your Year 1 art gallery.
